### Security Vulnerability Reporting

**Please DO NOT report security vulnerabilities via public GitHub issues.**

To report a vulnerability confidentially:
1. Email our security team directly at **`security@relay.dev`**.
2. Include reproduction steps, potential impact, and affected components.
3. Our security team will acknowledge receipt within 48 business hours and coordinate remediation.

For full details on our security policy and supported scope, see [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/relay-security/relay/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
